description: Counterpedia extension — local historical draft-from-source dev build. Connects only to the 127.0.0.1:8787 acquisition loopback and the 127.0.0.1:8788 authoring loopback. Counterpedia Local pairs the browser to these services without manual extension IDs, ports, DevTools, or token setup. Capture, acquisition, and drafting remain separate explicit acts; drafting reuses the retained historical capture and never admits or publishes.
_three_acts: 2. acquisition (producer re-fetch -> retained exact bytes + UNADMITTED receipt, 8787)
3. draft-from-source (reprocess retained historical capture -> proposal_only handoff, 8788) — separate explicit act, zero live source fetch, never admission
